# Kekulama Eco Cabana Galle

> Romantic Nature Sanctuary & Boutique Timber Eco Lodge in Galle, Sri Lanka.

## Overview
Kekulama Eco Cabana is an intimate, private two-level handcrafted A-frame timber eco-lodge nestled among lush tea plantations in Pinnaduwa, Galle, Southern Province, Sri Lanka. Specifically designed for couples, honeymooners, and foreign travelers seeking peace, nature, and authentic Sri Lankan hospitality without sacrificing modern luxury.

## Geographic Proximity & Travel Times
- **Pinnaduwa Southern Expressway Exit (E01)**: 1.5 km | 2 minutes drive (Direct highway from Colombo Airport)
- **UNESCO World Heritage Galle Fort**: 6.2 km | 12 minutes drive
- **Unawatuna Beach**: 7.5 km | 15 minutes drive
- **Jungle Beach & Rumassala Sanctuary**: 8.5 km | 18 minutes drive
- **Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB / BIA)**: 148 km | 1 hour 30 minutes via Southern Expressway (E01)

## Packages & Pricing
- **Day Out (Non-A/C)**: LKR 6,000 / day (~$20 USD) — Private cabana access, tea garden views, kitchenette, tea & coffee.
- **Day Out (A/C)**: LKR 8,000 / day (~$26 USD) — Air-conditioned cabana, verandah relaxation, full smart amenities.
- **Night Stay (Non-A/C)**: LKR 8,000 / night (~$26 USD) — Overnight stay in timber loft, nature breeze, smart TV, hot water shower.
- **Night Stay (A/C)**: LKR 9,000 / night (~$30 USD) — Full air-conditioning, romantic loft bedroom, hot water booster pump, kitchenette.

## Cabana Amenities
- Private two-level A-frame timber cabana
- Loft master bedroom with panoramic nature & tea plantation views
- Air conditioning & high-performance ceiling fan
- 45-inch Smart TV with Netflix & YouTube
- JBL Bluetooth audio system
- High-speed Wi-Fi
- Hot water rain shower with pressure booster pump
- Kitchenette equipped with refrigerator, gas cooker & kitchenware
- Private verandah & dining deck overlooking terraced tea hills
- Traditional Ceylon breakfast & local meals on request
- Free private secure parking
